name: Mandelbulb Sphere Tracing
definition: Sphere tracing applied to the Mandelbulb fractal. Uses a specific distance estimator function `distMandelBulb` instead of a generic shape distance function.
summary: Mandelbulb Sphere Tracing renders the Mandelbulb fractal by raymarching through 3D space using an iterative spherical power Signed Distance Function, distinguishing itself from standard primitive tracing through computationally expensive fractal boundary approximation.
